dismantling.title: Auto dismantling
dismantling.tagline: From the vehicle to every spare part
dismantling.intro: Manage dismantling in one system: keep vehicle records, track profitability and add removed parts manually or from Vortex catalogs.
dismantling.vehicle.label: Vehicle record
dismantling.vehicle.title: All vehicle information in one place
dismantling.vehicle.description: Every vehicle has its own record. Enter its specifications and acquisition cost to keep essential information at hand throughout dismantling.
dismantling.earnings.title: Profitability of every vehicle
dismantling.earnings.description: View earnings statistics and the acquisition cost for a specific vehicle. Assess the financial result of each dismantling job individually.
dismantling.inventory.title: Parts with a known origin
dismantling.inventory.description: See the list of parts recorded from this vehicle. The link between the vehicle and its removed parts stays in your records.
dismantling.statuses.label: Dismantling statuses
dismantling.statuses.title: Vehicles in progress and dismantling history
dismantling.statuses.description: Keep current and completed dismantling jobs separate to find the vehicles you need and revisit their history.
dismantling.active.label: Active vehicles
dismantling.active.title: Currently being dismantled
dismantling.active.description: Work with vehicles that still have parts to remove. Their details, financial figures and recovered parts are kept together.
dismantling.archived.label: Inactive vehicles
dismantling.archived.title: Dismantled earlier, kept in your history
dismantling.archived.description: Completed dismantling jobs remain available to view. Return to a vehicle record to check its results and the origin of removed parts.
dismantling.parts.label: Removing parts
dismantling.parts.title: Remove the parts. Vortex helps with the records.
dismantling.parts.description: From a vehicle to a specific part, using the approach that suits you. Enter the part manually or find it in Vortex catalogs for that vehicle.
dismantling.method.manual.title: Add manually
dismantling.method.manual.description: Enter the part yourself and add it to the vehicle’s removed parts records. A direct approach when you already know what you are removing.
dismantling.method.diagram.title: Find it on a diagram
dismantling.method.diagram.description: Select the vehicle in the Vortex catalog, open the relevant diagram and locate the part. Visual selection helps you navigate the assembly.
dismantling.method.groups.title: Choose from catalog groups
dismantling.method.groups.description: Browse parts groups for the selected vehicle. Open the relevant section, such as body components, and select the part.
dismantling.workflow.title: How catalog selection works
dismantling.workflow.vehicle: Fully select the vehicle in the Vortex catalog.
dismantling.workflow.catalog: Open an assembly diagram or the relevant parts group.
dismantling.workflow.part: Choose the part you are removing from this vehicle.
dismantling.workflow.example: For example: a specific vehicle → body components → the required body part. You work with the catalog for the selected vehicle.
tecdoc.heroDescription: Parts selection, vehicle identification and technical data for your business. TecDoc Web Catalog 3.0 from Vortex.
tecdoc.aboutTitle: Why do you need TecDoc, and why buy it from Vortex?
tecdoc.aboutCatalog: TecDoc Web is an online parts catalog containing information about vehicles and products from around the world. It is also a large aftermarket parts database with dimensions, photographs and additional part specifications supplied directly by manufacturers. Our catalog gives workshop professionals comprehensive vehicle identification information and a suitable selection of spare parts for the vehicle.
tecdoc.aboutSearch: Maintenance information and convenient features include VIN filters, brand filtering and a product group tree for easier browsing. In this catalog you can find part numbers and their vehicle applications, as well as equivalent parts from other manufacturers and original equipment part numbers.
tecdoc.resellerDescription: We are an official TecDoc reseller in Ukraine, ensuring reliable and legitimate services. Our favorable cooperation terms allow us to offer the best prices on the market.
tecdoc.expertiseDescription: Access to our services is quick and easy: just a few clicks and you can use the powerful TecDoc tool for your business. Our team has 17 years of experience in automotive parts and is always ready to share its knowledge and provide expert advice.
tecdoc.dataDescription: We have done extensive work with equivalent parts and data to make your business more efficient. You can confidently rely on our expertise in automotive parts.
tecdoc.catalogTitle: Speed up parts sales with the TecDoc catalog
tecdoc.catalogDescription: Benefit from our unique experience in the automotive parts market.
